item.name: 04 Inventario v3 cambio funcional y compatibilidad

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200', function () { if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('HTTP ' + pm.response.code); });
const track = pm.response.headers.get('X-App-Track');
const version = pm.response.headers.get('X-App-Version');
pm.test('La instancia identifica version y track', function () {
if (!['stable', 'canary'].includes(track)) throw new Error('Track ausente o invalido');
if (version !== (track === 'stable' ? '2.0.0' : '3.0.0')) throw new Error('Version y track no coinciden');
if (!pm.response.headers.get('X-App-Revision')) throw new Error('Falta revision');
const candidate = pm.response.json().resultados;
pm.test('V3 calcula estado y reposicion', function () {
if (!Array.isArray(candidate) || candidate.length === 0) throw new Error('Se necesita inventario para demostrar el cambio');
for (const row of candidate) {
const state = row.stock_disponible === 0 ? 'agotado' : row.stock_disponible <= row.stock_minimo ? 'bajo' : 'normal';
if (row.estado_stock !== state || row.unidades_reponer !== Math.max(0, row.stock_minimo - row.stock_disponible)) throw new Error('Calculo de stock incorrecto');
pm.sendRequest({url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{base_url}}') + '/api/v2/inventario/query', method: 'QUERY',
header: {'X-Api-Key': pm.variables.get('team_api_key'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
body: {mode: 'raw', raw: '{}'}}, function (error, baseline) {
pm.test('V3 conserva todos los campos de v2', function () {
if (error || baseline.code !== 200) throw new Error('No se pudo consultar baseline');
const rows = baseline.json().resultados;
if (rows.length !== candidate.length) throw new Error('Cantidad de filas diferente');
for (const old of rows) {
const current = candidate.find(row => row.sku_id === old.sku_id && row.almacen_id === old.almacen_id);
if (!current || Object.keys(old).some(key => JSON.stringify(old[key]) !== JSON.stringify(current[key]))) throw new Error('Contrato o inventario diferente');

item.name: Enviar lectura publica y contar track

request.description: Ejecutar SOLO esta carpeta en Runner con 100 iteraciones. No sustituye la carga concurrente ni la decision SLO del controlador. Durante regresion, 500 canary es un fallo intencional que se registra.

exec: const track = pm.response.headers.get('X-App-Track');
const version = pm.response.headers.get('X-App-Version');
pm.test('La instancia identifica version y track', function () {
if (!['stable', 'canary'].includes(track)) throw new Error('Track ausente o invalido');
if (version !== (track === 'stable' ? '2.0.0' : '3.0.0')) throw new Error('Version y track no coinciden');
if (!pm.response.headers.get('X-App-Revision')) throw new Error('Falta revision');
pm.test('Respuesta publica observable', function () {
if (![200, 500].includes(pm.response.code)) throw new Error('HTTP inesperado: ' + pm.response.code);
if (pm.response.code === 500 && track !== 'canary') throw new Error('Fallo inesperado en stable');
if (['stable', 'canary'].includes(track)) {
const variable = 'public_' + track;
pm.collectionVariables.set(variable, Number(pm.collectionVariables.get(variable) || 0) + 1);
pm.collectionVariables.set('public_total', Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('public_total') || 0) + 1);
if (pm.response.code >= 500) pm.collectionVariables.set(track + '_5xx', Number(pm.collectionVariables.get(track + '_5xx') || 0) + 1);
const total = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('public_total'));
const canary = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('public_canary') || 0);
console.log('Muestra publica', {total, stable: total - canary, canary, canary_percent: 100 * canary / total});
pm.test('Muestra acumulada: ' + canary + ' canary de ' + total, function () {});
